newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at highest since Sept '96.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at highest since Sept '96.

text.p: Palladium fixed at $124.30 per ounce on Monday, its highest fixing since September 9, 1996.
The market was firm all last week and rose from its Friday fixing of $123.65 on consumer and speculative buying.
The fresh high continued a trend which began earlier this year when supply contract talks for 1997 between Russia and Japan were postponed.
Dealers said consumers were active buyers in Tokyo earlier today on concerns that the market would tighten before an agreement could be reached on deliveries from Russia.
